sources.name: Ghana Statistical Service (statsghana.gov.gh)
sources.api: No API on the publisher's own site. The homepage carries headline aggregates (CPI inflation 5.5% Oct 2026, PPI 4.8% Sep 2026, IIP 3.0% 2026Q2, PBCI 5.1% Sep 2026, GDP growth) and census products (PHC/IBES); its 'Open Data' link resolves to dataportals.org's record of ghana_opendataforafrica (the AfDB Open Data Platform instance for Ghana - country/indicator aggregate series owned by third-party datasources).

license_evidence: Publisher instrument (2026-11-07): rendered homepage footer reads '© 2026 | Ghana...' with no licence or terms-of-use link in the footer; the only legal-adjacent links are 'Legal Mandate' and 'Privacy & Confidentiality' - neither is a data licence (Legal Mandate describes the Service's statutory basis).

The 'Open Data for Africa' link points to dataportals.org/portal/ghana_opendataforafrica - an aggregator record, not a publisher licence instrument; the underlying series belong to third-party datasources, the same family defect as uneca-ecastats-coverage (mirror risk, aggregate-only).
split_strategy: Not applicable (coverage sweep; closed at triage - bare copyright plus aggregate-only content).

measurements.channel_sweep_2026_11_07: GET https://statsghana.gov.gh/ rendered: bare-copyright footer, legal-mandate/privacy links only, 'Open Data for Africa' link to the AfDB platform record, headline aggregate indicators on the home surface. Commands in notes.md.

rejection_reason: Closed under the class C standing policy combined with a content-family defect: the Service's own site publishes under bare copyright with no redistribution grant on any instrument read, and the visible content is aggregate indicator releases and census products (the same aggregate-only weakness already recorded for statcan-wds-aggregate-series and uneca-ecastats-coverage, compounded by the same mirror risk via the AfDB-hosted 'Open Data for Africa' gateway). This sweep complements gh-opendata-coverage (portal TCP-refused, closed 2026-10-27) and gh-bog-treasury-auction (bare copyright, closed 2026-11-07): Ghana's three most obvious publishers are now all on record, so a future Ghana-focused tick does not re-read them from zero.
review: Cheap, decisive and worth recording: the Ghana sweep now covers the open-data portal (unreachable), the statistics office (bare copyright + aggregates) and the central bank (bare copyright). The pattern matches Kenya's: Ghana's task-shaped channels exist, but none is publishable under current terms.
next_action: Closed 2026-11-07. Reopen ONLY if: (a) the Service states a data licence permitting redistribution of derived rows on its own instrument (re-check the footer and legal pages); or (b) the operator records an explicit candidate-specific risk acceptance per skills/dataset-discovery/references/licence-posture.md. Even then, a reopen must find unit-level/event-grain content - none was visible on the home surface or through its open-data link; the AfDB-platform gateway is the aggregate family already dropped with uneca-ecastats-coverage.
